stemMd: A cooperative will replace its accountant with software, predicting that it will save the accountant's entire annual fee. Which assumption is necessary?

options.label: A
options.textMd: The software can calculate more rapidly than the accountant.

options.label: B
options.textMd: The replacement will introduce no new annual expense that offsets any part of that fee saving.

options.label: C
options.textMd: The accountant works for other clients.

explanationMd: Saving the entire fee is stronger than saving some money. Subscription, maintenance, or additional staff time would reduce the net saving. The absolute amount claimed requires the absence of any offsetting new annual expense.

distractorRationale.d: Debt is not necessary to the cost comparison.
distractorRationale.e: Report appearance does not determine cost.
distractorRationale.a: Speed does not establish the full net saving.
distractorRationale.c: Other clients are irrelevant to the cooperative's costs.
